 Ishwar

 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri B.K. Upadhyay - Government Advocate for State.

Order 
This is first application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail relating to Crime No.549/2023 registered by Police Station - Athner, District Betul (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in custody since 28.11.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation of abduction and rape is alleged against the applicant.
On the basis of which, FIR was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3 . Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix in her 183 of BNSS statement has not stated against the applicant regarding commission of rape.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of applicant.

He is in custody since NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:18222 2 MCRC-59457-2025 13.01.2026.
Therefore, it has been prayed that applicant/accused be enlarged on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the Ishwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82922167/
1 satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

sentences.text:
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
